Requirement: The network device must be configured to assign appropriate user roles or access levels to authenticated users.
FortiNAC setting: Administrators and administrator profiles (permissions, landing page, login availability)
FortiNAC command: GUI: Users & Hosts > Administrators

Requirement: The network device must produce audit log records containing sufficient information to establish what type of event occurred.
FortiNAC setting: Events and event management (enable events, thresholds, internal and external logging)
FortiNAC command: GUI: Logs > Events > Event management

Requirement: The network device must generate audit records containing information that establishes the identity of any individual or process associated with the event.
FortiNAC setting: Admin auditing log (who changed what and when; CLI changes as CLI Tool)
FortiNAC command: GUI: Logs > Audit Logs

Requirement: The network device must prevent the installation of patches, service packs, or application components without verification the software component has been digitally signed using a certificate that is recognized and approved by the organization.
FortiNAC setting: Secure boot, file integrity verification, and signed firmware enforcement
FortiNAC command: get system status

Requirement: The network device must be configured to use DoD PKI as multi-factor authentication (MFA) for interactive logins.
FortiNAC setting: Multi-factor authentication for administrators (token by SMS or email; individual and global)
FortiNAC command: GUI: System > Settings > Authentication > Multi-factor Authentication

Requirement: The network device must be configured to authenticate each administrator prior to authorizing privileges based on assignment of group or role.
FortiNAC setting: Administrator authentication by LDAP or RADIUS (Auth Type) and administrator profile mappings
FortiNAC command: GUI: Users & Hosts > Administrators

Requirement: The network device must require that when a password is changed, the characters are changed in at least eight of the positions within the password.
FortiNAC setting: Local administrator passwords (character rules; no length or complexity policy)
FortiNAC command: GUI: Users & Hosts > Administrators

Requirement: The network device must prohibit installation of software without explicit privileged status.
FortiNAC setting: Firmware upgrades (Updates > System, or execute restore image); Secure boot, file integrity verification, and signed firmware enforcement
FortiNAC command: GUI: System > Settings > Updates > System

Requirement: The network device must enforce access restrictions associated with changes to device configuration.
FortiNAC setting: Admin auditing log (who changed what and when; CLI changes as CLI Tool); Admin audit and event logging of port enforcement changes, data exports, and syslog forwarding
FortiNAC command: GUI: Logs > Audit Logs

Requirement: The network device must authenticate Network Time Protocol sources using authentication that is cryptographically based.
FortiNAC setting: NTP and time zone (UTC in the database)
FortiNAC command: config system ntp; set ntpserver <NTP_SERVER_1> <NTP_SERVER_2>; set ntpsync enable; end

Requirement: The network device must install security-relevant firmware updates within 30 days unless the time period is directed by an authoritative source (e.g., IAVM, CTOs, DTMs, STIGs).
FortiNAC setting: Firmware upgrades (Updates > System, or execute restore image); Firmware upgrade from the FortiGuard Distribution Network
FortiNAC command: GUI: System > Settings > Updates > System

Requirement: The network device must be configured to conduct backups of system level information contained in the information system when changes occur.
FortiNAC setting: Database and system backups (scheduled tasks), remote backup over SSH or FTP, and configuration backup from the CLI; Secure FTP remote backup
FortiNAC command: GUI: System > Settings > System management > Remote backup configuration; execute backup config scp <FILE> <SERVER> <USER> <PASSWORD>

Requirement: The network device must be configured to implement multifactor authentication for local; network; and/or remote access to privileged accounts; and/or nonprivileged accounts such that one of the factors is provided by a device separate from the system gaining access.
FortiNAC setting: SAML SSO for administrators and users, and FortiCloud SSO for admin login; Multi-factor authentication for administrators (token by SMS or email; individual and global)
FortiNAC command: GUI: Network > Service Connectors > Admin SAML SSO

Requirement: The network device must be configured to verify, when users create or update passwords, the passwords are not found on the list of commonly used, expected, or compromised passwords in IA-5 (1) (a) for password-based authentication.
FortiNAC setting: Local administrator passwords (character rules; no length or complexity policy)
FortiNAC command: GUI: Users & Hosts > Administrators

Requirement: The network device must be configured to protect nonlocal maintenance sessions by separating the maintenance session from other network sessions with the system by logically separated communications paths.
FortiNAC setting: Management (port1) and portal/isolation (port2) interfaces; CLI over SSH and the console; Out-of-band management in high availability configurations (ports 3 to 6)
FortiNAC command: config system global; set management port1; set portal port2; end

Requirement: The network device must be configured to include only approved trust anchors in trust stores or certificate stores managed by the organization.
FortiNAC setting: Certificate management (server certificates for Admin UI, portal, agent, and RADIUS; trusted certificates)
FortiNAC command: GUI: System > Certificate management

Requirement: The network device must be configured to synchronize system clocks within and between systems or system components.
FortiNAC setting: NTP and time zone (UTC in the database)
FortiNAC command: config system ntp; set ntpserver <NTP_SERVER_1> <NTP_SERVER_2>; set ntpsync enable; end

Requirement: The network device hardware and software must be a version supported by the vendor.
FortiNAC setting: Firmware upgrades (Updates > System, or execute restore image); FortiNAC-F VM SKUs and FortiNAC-OS (FortiOS-like CLI, firmware image) replacing CentOS 7; Migration of legacy CentOS C-series appliances to FortiNAC-OS; and 2 more
FortiNAC command: GUI: System > Settings > Updates > System

Requirement: AAA Services must be configured to automatically remove temporary user accounts after 72 hours.
FortiNAC setting: Guest and contractor accounts, templates, and sponsors
FortiNAC command: GUI: Users & Hosts > Guests & Contractors > Guest & Contractor templates

Requirement: AAA Services must be configured to automatically remove authorizations for temporary user accounts after 72 hours.
FortiNAC setting: Guest and contractor accounts, templates, and sponsors; Re-registration period for guest and contractor hosts
FortiNAC command: GUI: Users & Hosts > Guests & Contractors > Guest & Contractor templates

Requirement: AAA Services must be configured to automatically disable accounts after a 35-day period of account inactivity.
FortiNAC setting: Aging of host and user records
FortiNAC command: GUI: System > Settings > User/Host Management > Aging

Requirement: AAA Services must be configured to audit each authentication and authorization transaction.
FortiNAC setting: Events and event management (enable events, thresholds, internal and external logging); Live authentication logs (LDAP, Local, RADIUS, SAML, Social)
FortiNAC command: GUI: Logs > Events > Event management

Requirement: AAA Services must be configured to use secure protocols when connecting to directory services.
FortiNAC setting: LDAP directories (SSL or STARTTLS security protocol, synchronization of users and groups)
FortiNAC command: GUI: System > Settings > Authentication > Directories

Requirement: AAA Services must be configured to use protocols that encrypt credentials when authenticating clients, as defined in the PPSM CAL and vulnerability assessments.
FortiNAC setting: Captive portal and portal SSL certificate; RADIUS over TLS (RadSec) for the Local RADIUS Server
FortiNAC command: GUI: Portal > Portal SSL

Requirement: AAA Services must be configured to prohibit or restrict the use of organization-defined functions, ports, protocols, and/or services, as defined in the PPSM CAL and vulnerability assessments.
FortiNAC setting: Interface access services (set allowaccess: SSH, Admin UI, SNMP, syslog, RADIUS, agent, DHCP, DNS, and others)
FortiNAC command: config system interface; edit <PORT>; set allowaccess <ACCESS_LIST>; next; end

Requirement: AAA Services must be configured to uniquely identify and authenticate organizational users.
FortiNAC setting: Administrator authentication by LDAP or RADIUS (Auth Type) and administrator profile mappings; Microsoft Entra ID as a native authentication source (802.1X and portal)
FortiNAC command: GUI: Users & Hosts > Administrators

Requirement: AAA Services used for 802.1x must be configured to uniquely identify network endpoints (supplicants) before the authenticator establishes any connection.
FortiNAC setting: Local RADIUS server (802.1X EAP termination; EAP types TLS, TTLS, PEAP, MD5, GTC, MSCHAPv2, FAST, TEAP)
FortiNAC command: GUI: Network > RADIUS > Configure Local Server

Requirement: AAA Services must be configured to encrypt transmitted credentials using a FIPS-validated cryptographic module.
FortiNAC setting: TLS service configurations (Admin UI, Persistent Agent, and RADIUS EAP certificates, protocols, and ciphers); RADIUS over TLS (RadSec) for the Local RADIUS Server; TEAP for RADIUS clients and TLS 1.3 in the Local RADIUS Server
FortiNAC command: GUI: System > Settings > Persistent Agent > Transport configurations

Requirement: AAA Services must be configured to only accept certificates issued by a DoW-approved certificate authority (CA) for Public Key Infrastructure (PKI)-based authentication.
FortiNAC setting: Certificate management (server certificates for Admin UI, portal, agent, and RADIUS; trusted certificates)
FortiNAC command: GUI: System > Certificate management

Requirement: AAA Services must be configured to not accept certificates that have been revoked for PKI-based authentication.
FortiNAC setting: OCSP certificate revocation checking for EAP-TLS; OCSP soft-fail flag for certificate-based RADIUS authentication
FortiNAC command: GUI: Network > RADIUS > Configure Local Server

Requirement: AAA Services must be configured to map the authenticated identity to the user account for PKI-based authentication.
FortiNAC setting: Client certificate attribute ranking for user authentication (CN, DNS, UPN)
FortiNAC command: GUI: Network > RADIUS > Configure Local Server

Requirement: AAA Services must be configured to send audit records to a centralized audit server.
FortiNAC setting: Log receivers (Syslog CSV, Syslog CEF, SNMP trap, FortiAnalyzer OFTP)
FortiNAC command: GUI: System > Settings > System communication > Log receivers

Requirement: AAA Services used for 802.1x must be configured to authenticate network endpoint devices (supplicants) before the authenticator establishes any connection.
FortiNAC setting: Local RADIUS server (802.1X EAP termination; EAP types TLS, TTLS, PEAP, MD5, GTC, MSCHAPv2, FAST, TEAP); Machine authentication with RBAC based on Active Directory computer groups
FortiNAC command: GUI: Network > RADIUS > Configure Local Server

Requirement: AAA Services used for 802.1x must be configured to use secure Extensible Authentication Protocol (EAP), such as EAP-TLS, EAP-TTLS, and PEAP.
FortiNAC setting: Local RADIUS server (802.1X EAP termination; EAP types TLS, TTLS, PEAP, MD5, GTC, MSCHAPv2, FAST, TEAP); TEAP for RADIUS clients and TLS 1.3 in the Local RADIUS Server; TEAP with multiple inner authentication methods (user and machine)
FortiNAC command: GUI: Network > RADIUS > Configure Local Server

Requirement: AAA Services must be configured to use a unique shared secret for communication (i.e. RADIUS, TACACS+) with clients requesting authentication services.
FortiNAC setting: RADIUS secrets and RADIUS mode per modeled device; Require Message-Authenticator (BlastRADIUS protection); RADIUS over TLS (RadSec) for the Local RADIUS Server
FortiNAC command: GUI: Network > Inventory > Device configuration > Model configuration

Requirement: AAA Services must be configured to place non-authenticated network access requests in the Unauthorized VLAN or the Guest VLAN with limited access.
FortiNAC setting: Rogue host detection and isolation of unknown devices (registration, isolation, and dead-end VLANs); Guest and contractor accounts, templates, and sponsors
FortiNAC command: GUI: Network > Logical networks

Requirement: For public key-based authentication, AAA Services must be configured to implement a local cache of revocation data to support path discovery and validation.
FortiNAC setting: OCSP certificate revocation checking for EAP-TLS
FortiNAC command: GUI: Network > RADIUS > Configure Local Server

Requirement: AAA Services must be configured to include only approved trust anchors in trust stores or certificate stores managed by the organization.
FortiNAC setting: Certificate management (server certificates for Admin UI, portal, agent, and RADIUS; trusted certificates)
FortiNAC command: GUI: System > Certificate management
